thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#RDW-7892: KMS.Decrypt errors spike for prod keys (rdx-prod-*) across multiple services. Auto-detection: 5xx rate up 18% last 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/RDW-7892

pagerduty-bot: PD incident created and assigned. Severity: P1. First responder: Maya (oncall). Please ack.

Maya: acked. I'm on it. Seeing lots of KeyNotFound errors from the decrypt endpoint and some 429s too.

Maya: quick snapshot from k8s logs (ingestor-*)
```
2026-02-18T21:00:12Z ERROR decrypter.go:112 key=rdx-prod/abc123 err="KeyNotFound: key id not found"
2026-02-18T21:00:14Z WARN  decrypter.go:130 key=rdx-prod/abc123 err="KMS throttle: 429"
2026-02-18T21:00:18Z ERROR decrypter.go:112 key=rdx-prod/def456 err="KeyNotFound: key id not found"
```

Kara: was a key rotation scheduled? I thought we had a rotation job earlier today but not sure.

Maya: checked keymanager dashboard, no rotation job in the last 24h for rdx-prod aliases. Last successful rotation was 3 days ago.

Ravi: looking at HSM controller logs, some nodes failing HSM handshake during key lookup. snippet:
```
[HSM-ctl] 2026-02-18T20:59:58Z ERROR hsm-client: lookup failed: KEK not found for alias rdx-prod/abc123 (node hsm-03)
[HSM-ctl] 2026-02-18T21:00:05Z WARN  hsm-client: connection reset by peer
```

Maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic to a pre-provisioned fallback key alias (rdx-prod-fallback) for decrypts, 2) restart 3 ingestor replicas to pick up alias flip, 3) open support with KMS vendor and monitor. Will do steps 1-2 now on canary.

Dana: if we flip alias, will cached ciphertexts still decrypt? any format/version mismatch risk?

Maya: cached plaintext in memory is unaffected. Ciphertexts encrypted with older primary key will still decrypt if fallback key has been set up as a valid decryptor for that alias — we pre-provisioned it for emergency use. No re-encryption needed.

Maya: running command on canary ->
```bash
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/ingestor KMS_KEY_ALIAS=rdx-prod-fallback && kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/ingestor --selector=env=canary
```

OpsBot: rollout started for deployment/ingestor (canary).

Maya: canary restart completed. Metrics: decrypt errors from canary down from ~12/min to 0-1/min in 2m, latency stable. Prometheus graph: https://prom.example/graph?g0.expr=kms_decrypt_errors%7Bjob%3D%22ingestor%22%7D

Ravi: good signal. I'll escalate to infra oncall and open a support ticket with HSM vendor now, case #HV-9921. Sending logs and HSM node diagnostics.

Kara: if failover holds, we should page customers for a short degraded window and post to status page.

Maya: agreed. Drafting status update: "We experienced elevated KMS decrypt errors affecting a subset of requests. Temporary fallback key applied; most traffic recovered. We're working with our KMS provider to restore primary key access. No data loss observed." Posting to status shortly.

pagerduty-bot: PD update: escalated to L2 infra (Ravi). Next escalation timer set for 20 minutes.

Maya: handing off to Ravi for overnight monitoring and vendor coordination. Summary pinned: PD#RDW-7892, mitigation: fallback alias applied, canary verified, rollout in progress to remaining replicas, support case HV-9921 opened. I'll check back in 30m. :thumbsup:

Ravi: taking over. I'll keep thread updated and will escalate to HSM ops if vendor TTR exceeds 60m.

incident-bot: Note: on-call handoff recorded. Handoff from Maya -> Ravi at 2026-02-18T21:03:35Z.

Maya: thanks everyone. leaving notes in the incident doc.

Ravi: current status (21:06Z): decrypt error rate reduced to baseline ~0-2/min, some residual KeyNotFound in eu-west-1, support ticket open, continuing monitoring.

Dana: thanks for the quick mitigation. If vendor says root cause is replication lag, we should add a retry/backoff client-side patch in the short term.

Ravi: noted. Planning follow-up: (1) vendor postmortem, (2) add client retry for KeyNotFound with jitter, (3) run rotation sanity checks.

incident-bot: PD incident RDW-7892 -> status changed: monitoring.
